name: Modern Day 2026
description: The contemporary world: great-power competition, fragile institutions, and fast technology. Play any major power or carve your own path.

USA.name: United States
USA.note: Superpower balancing global commitments against domestic polarization.

CHN.note: Rising industrial and technological giant with regional ambitions.

RUS.note: Resource power leaning on energy leverage and military pressure.

IND.note: Fast-growing demographic giant courted by every bloc.

FRA.name: France
FRA.note: Nuclear power pushing European strategic autonomy.

GBR.name: United Kingdom
GBR.note: Atlanticist naval power seeking a post-Brexit role.

JPN.name: Japan
JPN.note: Technological power rearming under regional pressure.

BRA.name: Brazil
BRA.note: Continental power and agricultural giant of the Global South.

world.simulationRules: Contemporary realism: escalation is constrained by nuclear deterrence, alliances (NATO, etc.), markets, and domestic politics. Wars are rare, hybrid pressure and economic statecraft are common. Technology, elections, and public opinion matter.
